C0734.title: Insider Collusion Leads to Theft of 4 Million Yuan in Eggs at Xiangjia Shares, Six Employees Sentenced
C0734.summary: From January 2021 to September 2024, employees Wu, Jin, Chen, and Tang of Hunan Xiangjia Animal Husbandry Co., Ltd. exploited their positions as non-breeding egg warehouse keepers to collude with external buyers Yao and Wang.
